profile_deepspeed_model: profile a PyTorch model using DeepSpeed's flops profiler to get MACs and parameter count
profile_fvcore_model: profile a PyTorch model using fvcore's FlopCountAnalysis to get FLOPs and activation counts
test_profile_deepspeed: test the profile_deepspeed function with a sample model and input tensor
test_profile_fvcore: test the profile_fvcore function with a sample model and input tensor
